description: Lumileds datasheet curves for the LEDs on LEDBrick emitters. Generates components/ledbrick_scheduler/led_models.cpp (gen_led_models.py).
conventions: Relative output is 1.0 at the test current (350 mA LUXEON C, 1500 mA Rubix) at Tj = 85 C. Temperature curves are vs junction temperature, 1.0 at 85 C. Digitized from the PDF vector paths (Rubix 2026: raster) and checked against the figures.
not_published: Neither DS144 nor DS309 contains peak/dominant-wavelength-shift vs current, or chromaticity/CCT-shift vs current or temperature figures. Only temperature coefficients of wavelength (Table 2a) and of Vf (Table 3) are given.
